patches_added.name: Blur behind menus
patches_added.description: Blurs the screen behind the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, and behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets, like on an iPhone. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Fix videos in chat heads
patches_added.description: Draws videos in a chat head like the rest of the chat instead of on a separate layer, which some phones showed as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. Videos in the app itself are left as they are.

patches_added.name: Live captions on calls
patches_added.description: Shows what the other people say during a call as captions over Messenger. Your phone makes them itself, and it can translate them into your language and read them aloud. It needs Android 13 or newer with speech recognition on the phone. While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Send Instants from your gallery
patches_added.description: Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your phone's gallery app instead of taking a photo. The photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Special contacts
patches_added.description: Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. The history stays on this phone, and you can read it in HushMessenger settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.description: Tapping an audio or video call button asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. That covers a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen. patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB

patches_modified.name: Hide Grok buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image

patches_modified.name: Show poll results

patches_modified.name: Show sensitive media

patches_modified.name: Support external downloader

patches_added.name: Hide Inbox updates
patches_added.description: Leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox, so it doesn't load. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and so do the activity updates in that section. Your messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Filter feed
patches_modified.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved and Pinterest's suggestion rows out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant
patches_modified.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches_modified.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_modified.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses.
